_meta.name: May 2024 Superstorm
_meta.notes: First G5 storm since 2003. Multiple CMEs merged en route (cannibal CME). Aurora visible to 26° magnetic latitude — seen in Florida, Mexico, Spain. Best-observed extreme storm in history.
_meta.impact: Widespread aurora to low latitudes, GPS degradation for precision agriculture, some satellite drag anomalies, no major grid damage due to preparedness
